mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.permission_code, COALESCE(p.permission_name, p.permission_code) AS permission_name, p.status FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.permission_code

SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE rp.permission_id = #{permissionId} AND r.role_code IS NOT NULL AND r.role_code <> '' ORDER BY r.role_code
mapper.insert:

( #{roleId}, #{permissionId}, #{grantorId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, 0 )
